research_name: KR FLOW TO INTRADAY HIGH — 기관·외국인 수급 지속의 추가 예측력
question: Do point-in-time observable institutional/foreign flow persistence improve hit-rate and after-cost PnL vs identical price signal P alone?
not_assumed: selling exactly at the day's high
day high used only for evaluation labels
daily settled investor flow as intraday available
aggressive buy volume as investor net buy

price_rule_P.bars: completed non-interpolated 5m bars from KRX continuous-session observed 1m bars (5 positive-volume 1m bars each)
price_rule_P.trigger_time: only after C is complete and received
price_rule_P.population: first P event per symbol-date; do not replace with later successful P after flow filter drop

flow_rule.N0_N1_N2: latest three distinct same-day provisional investor aggregates available at signal time
flow_rule.foreign_persist_F: N2>0 and N1-N0>0 and N2-N1>0 (qty diffs across distinct rounds)
flow_rule.institution_persist_I: same as F on institution series
flow_rule.age_gt_90min: UNKNOWN in primary analysis (pre-fixed, not optimized); report excluded count
flow_rule.missing_vs_zero: missing is UNKNOWN, not 0 or net sell
flow_rule.program_and_broker_window: auxiliary only; never summed into one score with F/I

primary_flow_comparison: P+F+I vs P on flow-observable common population AND report full-P population separately

entry_eval.preferred: first valid ask after signal using quote+receive times; log VI/halt/limit/unfilled
entry_eval.proxy: next exact 1m open as PRICE_PROXY if only minutes; never fill gap with signal close
entry_eval.no_hit: neither barrier — report separately; keep in success-probability denominator
entry_eval.same_bar_both_barriers: report ambiguity rate; primary PnL stop-first; aux success bounds lo/hi
entry_eval.gap_through_stop: use observable price; do not clamp loss to -2%

costs_assumptions_for_sensitivity.label: ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY — not claimed as verified live account costs unless project evidence found

statistics.stability_split: first 70% / last 30% by date — diagnostic only; no re-tune on back
